profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: As a software engineer, I'm passionate about connecting with underrepresented groups in tech and making tools and jobs more accessible. I strive to create tools for developers that go beyond compliance with accessibility standards while also being financially accessible. I've been a keynote speaker on the Insider Dev Tour, spoken at TSConf, and have a patent for Software Quality Ticket Enrichment with AI.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full Stack developer on a service with SQL and Blob backend, .NET APIs, and TypeScript/React based website, as well as extensions for VS and Azure DevOps. Currently with a focus in security, testing/validation, telemetry, automated alerting, DevOps, and deployment.

positions.title: Gameplay Software Engineer and Designer
positions.description: Work as a software developer and engineer with a small team to create video games for kids 8-12 using LUA on the ROBLOX platform. Tasks include designing gameplay, environments, developing AI for NPCs, designing and monetizing tradable items, game balancing, and game maintenance.

company.name: Claremont Graduate University - Peter F. Drucker and Masatoshi Ito Graduate School of Management

positions.title: Equipment Manager
positions.description: Working individually and in small teams to organize equipment. Advanced use of Excel for tracking equipment and monetary transactions.

positions.title: Grutor
positions.description: Tutor students in CS05 and CS60 courses at HMC working in Python, Java, and Racket. Work one-on-one and in small groups.

positions.title: R&D Intern
positions.description: Worked on current product release designing and implementing a highly available distributed system. Wrote an API for internal and external communication with the service, designed and implemented a CLI, wrote documentation and presented at a poster session and to a specific Business Unit’s lead staff.

positions.title: IT Software Developer
positions.description: Specially asked to help design an iOS app for Scripps faculty, which I then developed and deployed in house as a one-man team. Gained experience meeting deadlines project, developing from scratch, learning a new language on the job and apple distribution policies, as well as balancing various simultaneous projects in machine setup, troubleshooting, secretarial, and technical support positions. Currently training a new team of interns and office heads to create a small department for iOS development within Scripps IT.

volunteerExperiences.description: I regularly organize and participate in Microsoft's GIVE campaign and have been co-lead for my divsion twice, helping to organizing a team of around 16 people, facilitating 15 or more events per year, and running a newsletter and website.
One of the leaders on the Microsoft LGBTQIA+ employee resource group at the divisional level. We organize social and educational events for members of our group and the entire division.
